summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of ACTOOS PRO B2B SaaS for field intervention management. Tested all 8 accounts (4 admin + 4 technician) and core business flows. All accounts login successfully. Demo mode, Planning, Clients, Interventions, Devis, Factures, and Chat features all working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Cookie consent popup is persistent and keeps reappearing even after accepting. It blocks UI interactions and requires force=True clicks to bypass. The localStorage key 'actoos_cookies_accepted' doesn't seem to persist properly across page navigations.

action_items: FIX: Cookie consent popup persistence - check localStorage key handling in CookieConsentSheet component. The popup should not reappear after user accepts cookies.
critical_code_review_comments: All 8 test accounts are working correctly with Supabase authentication
Demo mode (/demo) auto-login works and shows demo banner correctly
Admin dashboard shows correct metrics and navigation
Technician mobile app redirects correctly for tech accounts
Chat/Messaging feature works between admin and technicians
All CRUD pages (Clients, Interventions, Devis, Factures) load and display data correctly

success_rate.frontend: 95% (All features working, only cookie consent bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 accounts verified working. Cookie consent popup has persistence bug but can be bypassed with force=True clicks. Demo mode works via /demo URL. Admin accounts redirect to /dashboard, technician accounts redirect to /tech. Chat feature shows technicians list for admin. Planning shows weekly calendar with interventions.
